params.body:
This replaces PR #322, which conflicted with main in the generated `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` after #321 merged. Same change, rebased onto current main, with that file regenerated from scratch by `bin/rules-coverage --write` and `bin/rules-page`. The hand cannot update an existing branch, so this is a new branch and a new pull request; #322 can be closed.

Shane tested the unknown-chassis dialog on staging: "maar dit 'nummer aanpassen' is raar, welk nummer, en ook 2 rijen knoppen is raar". Three things, and behaviour changes in none of them.

## The buttons name the data, not "the number"

The dialog shows two numbers, the mileage and the chassis number, and step 2 lets the dealer edit both. A button about "het nummer" therefore cannot be read. The question is now `Kloppen deze gegevens?` and the three labels are `Ja, versturen`, `Aanpassen` and `Annuleren`: the confirm says what happens, "Aanpassen" refers to the values printed right above it, and cancelling is called cancelling (a "Nee" under a question about data reads as an answer, not as leaving). Step 2 keeps `Correctie versturen` / `Terug`, which read fine next to the new step 1.

Labels updated in all five languages (`vehicle.confirm_vin`, `vehicle.correct_vin`, `vehicle.unknown_vin_prompt`), plus `global.cancel` for Spanish, which fell back to the English "Cancel".

## Three buttons stack instead of wrapping

Fixed in the shared component, not by shortening labels until they happen to fit. Below `sm` the row is a `flex-col-reverse`: one button per line, full width, primary on top, in reading order. From `sm` up they sit on one row again, right aligned, primary on the right. Every screen in the application that opens a three-button dialog inherits this. Tailwind utilities only, no new CSS file and no new `ui-` class.

## The body is two sentences, and the part that matters carries weight

Six lines of grey text became two sentences: the reading goes into a public register under today's date, and confirming is only possible today. They stand as a warning with an amber left rule and a very light ground, no icon. The line that explained a button already on screen is gone. The billing claim removed in PR 312 is not back.

## Verification

Rendered through the application (own-stock list, the real `carpassChip` component, the server-rendered body), at 1280 px and at 390 px, where the buttons stack as intended. Rule R S3-2.17 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/13-s3-car-pass.md` follows the new labels, the stacking rule and the shortened text; `docs/bedrijfsregels.html` regenerated from scratch (`bin/rules-coverage --write` left `92-testdekking.md` unchanged, it was already current).

`php artisan test --filter='Carpass|CarPass|OwnStockRowMarkup|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|RulesCoverage'`: 76 tests, 859 assertions, green. Four assertions in `CarpassRequestFeedbackTest` named the old labels and now name the new ones; the test that pins what the dialog may claim gained two assertions (the question is about the data, and the body no longer explains a button).
params.title: The unknown-chassis dialog says which data it means (rebased)
